name: Duo Security
description: Duo Security, part of Cisco, is an identity and access management platform providing multi-factor authentication, single sign-on, and device trust for securing logins.
best_for: Organizations of any size, including government agencies, that need phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication and zero-trust access controls.

tiers.name: Duo Free
tiers.notes: Capped at 10 users max, forever. Basic MFA (push/SMS/hardware token) and self-service enrollment; no SSO.

tiers.name: Duo Essentials
tiers.notes: Adds SSO, phishing-resistant MFA, and unlimited application integrations. Licenses are sold in increments of 10 seats (under 100 users) or 25 seats (over 100 users), not one seat at a time.

tiers.name: Duo Advantage
tiers.notes: Marked most popular; adds Cisco Identity Intelligence and risk-based authentication.

tiers.name: Duo Premier
tiers.notes: Adds a full Zero Trust access package and complete device trust with endpoint posture checks.

cons: Licenses must be purchased in fixed increments of 10 or 25 seats rather than per-actual-headcount, a pattern real customers have publicly called punitive for small businesses on Cisco's own community forum.
The permanent Free tier is hard-capped at 10 users with no SSO; any organization past 10 people must move to a paid tier immediately.

Risk-based authentication and Cisco Identity Intelligence are not included until the Advantage tier, and full device-trust Zero Trust access is Premier-only -- the advertised $3 entry price does not include the features most buyers actually want.
features: Multi-factor authentication supporting over 1.3 billion monthly authentications
Device trust to restrict access to trusted devices
Adaptive access policies based on risk factors
Admin dashboard for policy and user management

alternatives.name: Okta
alternatives.description: An identity and access management platform for single sign-on and user authentication.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises managing identity across many applications

alternatives.name: Auth0
alternatives.description: An identity platform for developers to add authentication and authorization to applications.
alternatives.best_for: Developers building custom login and authentication flows
